sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (submitted by Ethnologue Editor, SIL). 2011. Request for Change to ISO 639-3 Language Code, Change Request Number 2011-071: retire [pbz] Palu (dated 2011-03-17; adopted, effective 2012-02-03). 5 pp.

sources.note: Nothing about stress or any linguistic feature. p.2 section 3 (retire, reason 'There is no evidence that the language exists'): 'Nothing is known about this language; we have never heard of this language. No published sources cited.
